title: Dunkl--Pauli Oscillator in an Aharonov--Bohm Flux: Restriction of Admissible Angular Sectors and Thermodynamic Signatures
summary: We study a two-dimensional Dunkl--Pauli oscillator in the presence of an Aharonov--Bohm (AB) flux. The combination of reflection symmetry (via Dunkl operators) and a topological gauge field imposes a nontrivial constraint on the admissible quantum states: the regularity condition on radial wave functions, together with the matching conditions at the flux tube, leads to a compatibility relation $ν_1+\varepsilonν_2=0$ and forces the emergence of a lowest angular quantum number~$\ell_0$.
